title: Keio and MIT develop soft floating robot to reduce robotics #keio #roboticscreepiness #softrobotics
description: Keio University and MIT Media Lab developed a soft, helium-filled robot designed to move gently and avoid the uncanny valley effect common in traditional humanoid robots. It floats smoothly with no buzzing rotors or rigid parts, allowing safe human interaction without the typical creepiness. This innovative robot communicates through its body movement—hovering, drifting, and leaning—instead of using a face, making it more approachable and friendly. Its softness and lightness let users touch it safely, helping bridge the gap between machines and personal space like a pet might. The robot serves practical functions such as nudging people awake, acting as a study companion, encouraging movement, and even dancing. This approach may reshape how robots integrate into everyday life by emphasizing safety, comfort, and emotional connection over lifelike appearance. #KeioUniversity #MITMediaLab #SoftRobot #HeliumRobot #RoboticsInnovation #UncannyValley #HumanRobotInteraction #RobotDesign #WearableTech #AIrobotics #RoboticCompanion #RobotTechnology #SoftRobotics #RoboticsResearch #InteractiveRobots
